question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be established in living beings?
premises: The vital air is described as filled with breath.
This air is related to all living beings.
It is said to be situated within them.
inference: The breath-filled vital air is established in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam is irregular in the transmitted form.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
